digest.component_or_area: gate resolution and config error handling
propositions: gate_enabled currently catches ConfigError from unreadable rebar.toml and returns GateState.UNREADABLE, allowing operations to silently proceed as if the gate were disabled
unreadable config must raise ConfigError to the operation caller instead of being swallowed, so the operator sees and fixes the parse fault
gate_enabled must stop catching ConfigError and instead raise it chained from the parse fault with message naming gate label and ticket id
GateState.UNREADABLE is removed as unreachable after gate_enabled raises on parse errors; ENABLED/DISABLED states and bool compatibility are preserved
claim and close operations must fail loudly before acquiring locks when config is unreadable, leaving ticket in its prior state
ConfigError must be caught by a CLI boundary in main() to surface clean operator-facing error messages instead of tracebacks
